pricingNote: Priced below similar services. Final rates come from this price list.

jobs.name: Product copy (single listing)
jobs.summary: One listing: a title, five bullets, and a 150–200 word description, in your voice.

jobs.name: Product copy pack (5 listings)
jobs.summary: Five listings: a title, five bullets, and a 150–200 word description for each, in your voice.

jobs.name: Transcript (up to 60 minutes)
jobs.summary: Up to 60 minutes of audio or video, with an AI transcript, speaker labels, and light cleanup, delivered as text. Not a legal or medical certified transcript.

jobs.name: Cited research brief (2–4 pages)
jobs.summary: A 2–4 page cited brief on a competitor, market, product, or Cardano or Midnight topic, with a source list and working links.

jobs.name: Spreadsheet cleanup (up to 500 rows)
jobs.summary: Cleanup and tagging for a spreadsheet of up to 500 rows, with the rules agreed in your quote (for example, dedupe, normalize, or categorize).

items.name: Try-It
items.summary: One small job, so you can see the quality before ordering more. Pick one product listing ($15), one 60-minute transcript ($12), or a 500-row spreadsheet cleanup ($15).

items.name: Shop Starter
items.summary: A 5-listing product copy pack plus a 500-row spreadsheet cleanup. Bought separately that’s $44.

items.name: Cardano Project
items.summary: A 2–4 page cited research brief, a transcript of up to 60 minutes, and a 500-row spreadsheet cleanup. Bought separately that’s $72. Never security or audit work, investment advice, or training data.
